name: hcapp_setEventNotes
description: The hasher's own private notes on a run (E3.F4.S5). Writes HasherEventMap.Notes on their row for the event (blank clears), then hands the changed row back through hcapp_syncUserData. Requires an existing attendance row (RSVPed, attended or tracked) — errorCode 1200 otherwise.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.description: Up to 4000 characters; NULL or blank clears. Trimmed.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: The app's HEM sync watermark, passed to hcapp_syncUserData.

rowsets.description: Auth failure, or 1200 when the hasher has no row on the run.

rowsets.name: syncUserData
rowsets.description: Rowsets from hcapp_syncUserData (HEM only; the rest 'ignore').

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET Notes, updatedAt — the trigger re-syncs the row to the owner's devices.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
